decisions.reason: The sourceability impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY establishing the JLCPCB Extended-part policy; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The source requests review of costly passive-component selections but does not change the BOM completeness, part-number, or design-matching requirements.
Extended-part setup fees and passive package selections do not change the requirement that the KiCad project resolve without local-library warnings.
Reviewing passive-component setup fees does not entail any change to board dimensions, mounting, orientation, or enclosure fit.
The source concerns passive resistors and capacitors and does not change interboard connector types, pinouts, or power topology.
The setup-fee review does not alter the confirmed LED supply voltage, level-shifter requirement, or selected level-shifter part.
The client expects the AXP component itself to be Extended and does not change the AXP2101 power-path topology or operating constraints.
Passive-component setup-fee review does not change the 5V rail voltage, converter, GPIO control, loads, or shutdown behavior.
The source does not change the monitoring IC, measured rails, channel allocation, or monitor placement.
The assembly-cost concern does not alter the sensor-board connector inventory, connector pinouts, or module interfaces.
The source does not discuss or change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection used to select I2C mode.
Although passive components are mentioned generally, the source does not necessarily change the BOOT/reset controls or their specified capacitances.
